g.text: Solid arrow: reference Dashed arrow: dependency Filled diamond: ownership Hollow triangle: interface
All eight bot source types are shown. Strategies are stateless and share the interface contract.
BotController filters illegal +4 attempts and submits every decision to GameEngine.
Strategies use their own Player and candidate cards; they do not inspect opponents' hands.
